Hi Sasha / Elena —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

What we heard:
- Primary use case: reduce inference TCO for your patient-facing summarization pipeline while meeting sub-200ms latency SLOs for the mobile app.
- Main constraints: SOC 2 controls, VPC deployment preferred for PHI, and an initial pilot on a subset of traffic (10%).
- Success metrics: 30-40% cost reduction on tokens served, latency <200ms P95, and no regression on output quality.

Proposed next steps:
1) Executive alignment call (VP / CTO) to confirm scope, success metrics, and procurement path.
2) Technical deep dive/demo with our SE to walk the integration path and network/KMS options.
3) Share an initial mutual action plan and SOW draft (attached).

To get the exec intro scheduled, does any of these windows work for you (all PT)?
- Tue 2029-03-26: 10:00-11:00 
- Wed 2029-03-27: 13:00-14:00

If those don't work, please send 2-3 slots that do and I will coordinate with Rishi and Vivek. We attached a short one-pager and the initial MOPs/SOW draft for procurement.

Thanks - looking forward to aligning the execs and getting a technical deep dive on the calendar.
